import pytest
from subject import (
    HandlerGoldenChainGenerator,
    ModelGoldenChainGenerationRequest,
    ModelTicketContract,
    ModelGoldenChainEntry,
    ModelDeferredChainWarning,
    EnumGoldenChainGenerationStatus,
    ModelGoldenChainGenerationResult,
    _hash_json,
    _contract_hash,
    _chain_hash,
    _entries_from_contract,
    _warnings_from_contract,
)


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_insufficient_contract():
    contract = ModelTicketContract(
        ticket_id="ticket-insufficient",
        contract_fingerprint="fp-insufficient",
        golden_path=None,
    )
    request = ModelGoldenChainGenerationRequest(
        contract=contract,
        generator_version="gen-v1",
        template_hash="tmpl-hash",
        generated_test_hash="test-hash",
    )
    handler = HandlerGoldenChainGenerator()
    result = handler.handle(request)

    assert result.status == EnumGoldenChainGenerationStatus.INSUFFICIENT_CONTRACT
    assert result.expected_chain == ()
    assert len(result.deferred_warnings) == 1
    warning = result.deferred_warnings[0]
    assert warning.code == "GOLDEN_PATH_MISSING"
    assert warning.source_ref == "contract.golden_path"
    assert "No explicit golden_path is declared" in warning.detail

    assert result.ticket_id == contract.ticket_id
    assert result.generator_version == request.generator_version
    assert result.template_hash == request.template_hash
    assert result.generated_test_hash == request.generated_test_hash

    assert result.contract_hash == _contract_hash(contract)
    assert result.chain_hash == _chain_hash(result.expected_chain, result.deferred_warnings)


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_deferred_with_assertions():
    contract = ModelTicketContract(
        ticket_id="ticket-with-assertions",
        contract_fingerprint="fp-with-assertions",
        golden_path={
            "input": {"topic": "input-topic"},
            "output": {"topic": "output-topic", "assertions": ["assert-a", "assert-b"]},
        },
    )
    request = ModelGoldenChainGenerationRequest(
        contract=contract,
        generator_version="gen-v2",
        template_hash="tmpl-hash-2",
        generated_test_hash="test-hash-2",
    )
    handler = HandlerGoldenChainGenerator()
    result = handler.handle(request)

    assert result.status == EnumGoldenChainGenerationStatus.DEFERRED
    assert len(result.expected_chain) == 2
    entry_in, entry_out = result.expected_chain
    assert entry_in.sequence == 1
    assert entry_in.event_type == "golden_path_input"
    assert entry_in.topic == "input-topic"
    assert entry_in.source_node == "UNKNOWN"
    assert entry_out.sequence == 2
    assert entry_out.event_type == "golden_path_output"
    assert entry_out.topic == "output-topic"
    assert entry_out.source_node == "UNKNOWN"

    assert len(result.deferred_warnings) == 3
    warning_codes = {w.code for w in result.deferred_warnings}
    assert warning_codes == {"SOURCE_NODE_UNKNOWN", "ASSERTIONS_NOT_TOPOLOGY"}
    source_warnings = [w for w in result.deferred_warnings if w.code == "SOURCE_NODE_UNKNOWN"]
    assert len(source_warnings) == 2
    assert any(w.source_ref == "contract.golden_path.input.topic" for w in source_warnings)
    assert any(w.source_ref == "contract.golden_path.output.topic" for w in source_warnings)
    assert any(w.code == "ASSERTIONS_NOT_TOPOLOGY" for w in result.deferred_warnings)

    assert result.ticket_id == contract.ticket_id
    assert result.generator_version == request.generator_version
    assert result.template_hash == request.template_hash
    assert result.generated_test_hash == request.generated_test_hash

    assert result.contract_hash == _contract_hash(contract)
    assert result.chain_hash == _chain_hash(result.expected_chain, result.deferred_warnings)

@pytest.mark.unit
def test_contract_hash_excludes_fingerprint():
    base_path = {
        "input": {"topic": "base-in"},
        "output": {"topic": "base-out", "assertions": []},
    }
    c1 = ModelTicketContract(
        ticket_id="same-id",
        contract_fingerprint="fp-first",
        golden_path=base_path,
    )
    c2 = ModelTicketContract(
        ticket_id="same-id",
        contract_fingerprint="fp-second",
        golden_path=base_path,
    )
    assert _contract_hash(c1) == _contract_hash(c2)

    c3 = ModelTicketContract(
        ticket_id="different-id",
        contract_fingerprint="fp-first",
        golden_path=base_path,
    )
    assert _contract_hash(c1) != _contract_hash(c3)
